newsitem.title: USA: Consep sees no Bite Blocker revs in '96.
newsitem.headline: Consep sees no Bite Blocker revs in '96.

text.p: Consep Inc said it foresaw no meaningful revenues from its new Bite Blocker insect repellent this year.

The company said in a statement on Friday the Bite Blocker line "accounted for approxinately 30 percent of the increase in operating expenses for the three months ended Sept 30, 1996" over the same period the year before.

"In that the company does not expect to commence significant sales of the Bite Blocker product line until the first quarter of 1997, marketing costs related to the introduction of (the) ... product will continue to be incurred during the fourth quarter of 1996 without any significant revenue generation in 1996."
